11. CW-5 was examined as PW-2 Smt. Geetha Y K .

She has deposed in her examination in chief that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 12-12-2017 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subject her to any physical and mental cruelty in demand of dowry and did not gave life threat to her. PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.6 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P6a.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.7 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P7a and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.6 and P.7.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-2 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-2 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being police official witness deposed about the part of investigation done by him is only a formal in nature.
PW-2 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.

Therefore, this court was pleased to reject Girinagar Police Station vs Amith R on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128980484/

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
The available evidence of PW-1 is not sufficient to connect the accused with alleged offences.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness,
turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

 ORDER
